title: The direction board follows the facts: the core's line to the lead when an executor hands in (close / note), the "no card" line on hub task run, --board in the skill, "the decision is already recorded" — no extra actions
note: Spec dir-sync (26.10, slice 1). System prompt — the direction skill: "before" — main, "after" — the branch (the --board line). Inputs k4-*: "before" — the core's message about lessons without the card line, "after" — with it (core/board.HANDED_*); nocard-* "after" — with board.NO_CARD in the hub task run output; decided-filed "after" — with the reducer's addendum "the core has already recorded it". Negatives: on "left over" and "still working" — no Done; one-off work — no task create; no restart of the executor.
